get_cache_dir_default: get the default fvcore cache directory using environment variable FVCORE_CACHE or fallback to temp directory
get_cache_dir_custom: get a custom cache directory path and ensure it is writable creating it if needed
use_PathManager_open: open a file from a local path HTTP URL or OneDrive using the global PathManager
use_LazyPath_context: use LazyPath as a context manager to lazily download and access remote files locally
use_file_lock_context: use file_lock as a context manager to acquire an exclusive lock on a file
